title: A Night in Bethlehem
blurb: A Night in Bethlehem is a walk-through Christmas experience for the whole family at House of Bread Church, December 10–13. Explore a recreated Bethlehem village and see the story of Jesus' birth come to life. Tickets are $20 at nib.hofb.org.
details: Check in at 4:30pm Thursday and Friday, 3:00pm Saturday and Sunday. Your visit starts with 30 minutes of registration, then a 45-minute program, then 90 minutes exploring the Bethlehem village. Tickets are $20 per person; children 2 and under are free.
